S.No.
Delhi High Court Legal Services Committee is a statutory body constituted by
the State Legal Services Authority U/s. 8A of the Legal Services Authority Act. 1987.
The Committce provides free legal services to the eligible persons. The Committee
also conducts mediation programme for pre-litigation cases at the Crime Against
Women Cell, Nanakpura (Moti Bagh), Rani Bagh and Patparganj in association with
the Special Police Unit for Women and Children (Delhi Police).
The Committee hereby invites Online Applications for empanelment of
Advocates and Mediators for the period 01.01.2025 to 31.12.2027.

A. HOW TO APPLY
1. The Advocates are advised to read the instructions contained in the
advertisement carefully to ensure that they are eligible for empanelment in
Delhi High Court Legal Services Committee in terms of qualification, and
other specified terms and conditions.
2. The detailed instructions and terms and conditions of empanelment can be
accessed from our website (www.dhclsc.org). Applications shall be filled
online only w.e.f. 20.06.2024 till 11.07.2024 (5:00 P.M.).
3. The Advocate shall submit only one application and he/ she will be considered
for empanelment to one panel only. All applications of the Advocate applying
for more than one Panel will be rejected.
4. The Advocate must apply on the format prescribed by the Delhi High Court
Legal Services Committee only. No other format will be entertained.
5. Incomplete applications would be rejected.
6. DHCLSC reserves the right to shortlist Advocates to be called for interview.
3
7. Please mention all your details correctly, no request for subsequent
modification/ alteration shall be entertained.
8. Online applications shall be accepted from 20.06.2024 till 11.07.2024 (5:00
P.M.) After submitting online application form, it is mandatory to submit the
print out of the said application form along with attached documents to the
office of DHCLSC on or before 18.07.2024 till 5:00 P.M. No applications
whether online/ hardcopy shall be entertained for whatsoever reason after lapse
of the above mentioned dates.
9. After successful submission of Application Form, an Application Number shall
be generated, and the same shall be sent through e-mail.
10. In case, the applicant does not get a confirmation e-mail regarding successful
submission of online application form within 48 hours, he /she may contact the
office of DHCLSC on any working hours or call at 011-23383418.
B. INSTRUCTIONS
ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA :
1. The Advocate who possesses the following eligibility and experience can apply
for empanelment with Delhi High Court Legal Services Committee : -

2. The advocates applying for Civil, Criminal-I, Criminal -II, Matrimonial,
Labour and Jail Visiting Panel should have the experience of handling matters
in High Court for the minimum prescribed period either independently or under
a Senior member of the bar.
3. The advocates applying for Criminal-I, Criminal-II, Matrimonial Panel, Labour
Panel and Civil Panel have to submit copies of any 02 (two) orders/ judgments
passed by Hon’ble High Court of Delhi wherein they have independently
argued the matter.
4. The Advocates applying for Jail Visiting Panel shall submit copies of any 02
(two) petitions drafted by them in their name and filed before the Hon’ble High
Court of Delhi.
5. The advocates applying for jail visiting panel should be well conversant with
the Delhi High Court Rules, drafting of appeals/ petitions and parole/ furlough
guidelines.
6. The Advocate shall attach self attested photocopy of L.L.B. Degree and
Certificate of enrolment issued by State Bar Council under the Advocates Act,
1961 and an experience certificate issued by the Bar Association along with the
online application form.
7. Persons adjudged guilty under the Criminal Law, Contempt of Courts Act or
under the Advocates Act should not apply.
8. If it is found that the Advocate does not fulfil any of the eligibility conditions,
his or her candidature shall not be considered.
9. The Advocates on any panel of DHCLSC, interested in continuing on the same
panel or other panel, also need to apply afresh.
10. The Advocates who have been on the Panel of DHCLSC for three complete
terms are not eligible to be appointed again and so may not apply.
11. In terms of Section 9 of NALSA (Free and Competent Legal Services)
Regulations, 2010 (As amended vide notification F.No. L/61/10/NALSA dated
22.10.2018), retired Judicial Officers are also eligible to apply for the panels.
5
C. SELECTION PROCEDURE
1. No Advocate shall be called for interview unless he/ she satisfies the eligibility
conditions.
2. Merely fulfilling the eligibility criteria will not confer any right on an Advocate
to be called for interview or selection.
3. Depending upon the number of applications received, Monitoring Committee
of DHCLSC reserves the right to shortlist the Advocates to be called for
interview.
4. The decision of the Monitoring Committee of DHCLSC regarding shortlisting
of the Advocates for the interview call shall be final.
5. A list of shortlisted Advocates with the date, time and venue of Interview will
be displayed on the Notice Board of the Delhi High Court Legal Services
Committee, Delhi High Court, New Delhi and shall also be uploaded on our
website i.e. www.dhclsc.org. Shortlisted Advocates will be informed through e-
mail / telephone about the date, time and venue of interview.
6. The Advocate shall bring original documents at the time of interview.
7. The empanelment result will be displayed on our website www.dhclsc.org and
on the notice board of the Delhi High Court Legal Services Committee.
D. TERMS & CONDITIONS FOR EMPANELLED ADVOCATES
1. The new panel shall be for a period of three years commencing from the date of
appointment, subject to review of performance / work done by each Advocate
appointed.
2. Panel Advocates will be paid honorarium as per approved Fee Schedule of
DHCLSC.
3. DHCLSC will send the information to the panel advocates through email /
SMS regarding entrustment of a legal aid case and after receiving the email/
SMS, it shall be the duty of the panel Advocates to contact the Legal Aid
Beneficiary and pursue the matter.
4. It shall be mandatory for panel Advocates and Mediators to attend the
Orientation, capacity building programmes and refresher courses organized by
6
Delhi High Court Legal Services Committee from time to time. The
empanelled advocates would also be deputed for Front Office duties viz.
interaction with Legal Aid applicants.
5. In order to ensure that there is effective check on the legal aid and services
being rendered, the Advocates on the panel must regularly upload/ update the
status of the cases after each date of hearing on the portal of DHCLSC. Failure
to upload/ update the status of cases will be a ground for removal of the name
of the Advocate concerned from the panel.
6. Arguing Counsels should be willing to visit the jails, if required, and it is
mandatory for them to attend video conferencing sessions from Jail in respect
of cases assigned to them.
7. In appropriate cases, DHCLSC reserves the right to allocate cases to its
empanelled Advocates irrespective of the category / Panel assigned to them.
8. In case of contravention of any provision of relevant Acts, Rules &
Regulations, including the High Court Legal Services Regulations 1998 and
any other directions of DHCLSC, appropriate action shall be initiated qua the
empanelled Advocate or Mediator.
9. Any changes sought will be entertained only with the prior approval of the
Hon’ble Chairperson, DHCLSC.
Sd/-
Secretary, DHCLSC
